heroes.name: Daras
heroes.title: Nemesis Claw Fearmonger
heroes.description: The Fearmonger is not only a master of toxins and poisons, he also relishes the slow cruelties of their effects. Whether dispensing his vile concoctions in battle or infiltrating enemy encampments to taint rations, he spreads horror, suffering and death wherever he goes.

traits.name: Overwatch
traits.description: If this unit has not attacked during its turn, nor after that, it attacks when an enemy moves within range during the enemy's turn

traits.name: Camouflage
traits.description: Ranged attacks against this character score -1 hit. This increases to -2 hits if this character is more than 2 hexes away from the attacker or to -3 hits when in Tall Grass. Attackers always score at least 1 hit.

traits.name: Terrifying
traits.description: Takes [value unavailable]% Damage from Melee attacks

abilities.name: Proclivity for Murder
abilities.template: Deals 3x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage to all adjacent enemies. Any resulting Battle Fatigue is triggered twice. After using this ability, Daras may move again, even if he already moved this turn.
abilities.description: Deals 3x 3394-4046 Toxic Damage to all adjacent enemies. Any resulting Battle Fatigue is triggered twice. After using this ability, Daras may move again, even if he already moved this turn.

abilities.name: Terrorchem Poison
abilities.template: Daras' melee attacks apply Poisoned for 2 rounds. Affected enemies take 1x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage from the Poisoned effect at the start and end of their turns. Daras' melee attacks additionally apply Terrorchem Poison for 2 rounds. Affected enemies deal -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage and Health restored to them is reduced by {[healPct]}%.
abilities.description: Daras' melee attacks apply Poisoned for 2 rounds. Affected enemies take 1x 1828-2872 Toxic Damage from the Poisoned effect at the start and end of their turns. Daras' melee attacks additionally apply Terrorchem Poison for 2 rounds. Affected enemies deal -30% Damage and Health restored to them is reduced by 80%.

machines.name: Boudicari
machines.title: Contemptor-Achillus Dreadnought
machines.description: The Dreadnoughts of the Legio Custodes are advanced, beautiful machines that wed phenomenal strength and speed with the interred warrior’s own unmatched martial skill. In those isolated cases where a Custodian has sustained irrevocable harm with their mind intact, internment within the cold and unyielding body of a Dreadnought is assured, for no Custodian would tolerate an end to their service short of death.

abilities.name: Wrathful Advance
abilities.template:
Deploys Boudicari as a stationary unit in a 3 hex area on the battlefield. If they are summoned adjacent to a friendly character, they immediately perform a normal attack against a target in range.
After using this ability, Boudicari can no longer be used as a Machine of War for the rest of the battle.

{[summonDmg]} Damage

Initial cooldown: 2 rounds. 
Cost: 3 munition.

abilities.name: Relentless Persecution
abilities.template:
Targets an enemy unit that has been attacked by a friendly unit this turn and deals 1x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Las Damage to it. This attack deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each Active Ability that was used this turn.

Initial cooldown: 1 round.

This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.

abilities.name: Defiant to the Last
abilities.template: Friendly Mythic characters deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage if they have used an Active Ability this battle or are adjacent to Boudicari.
